intro.title: Introducing workflows
intro.body: Workflows let you choose what to make before you start. Besides highlights, one video can now become a numbered series, every clip about a topic, a recap, or a trailer. Here’s a one-minute look at each.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.body: What you already know: the best moments, each one working on its own. This is still the default.

series.title: Series
series.body: Turns a long video into numbered parts that play in order, each leaving people wanting the next. Great for stories and tutorials.

topic.title: Topic
topic.body: Name a subject and get every strong moment about it, like “pricing” in a long interview. You type it in the line that appears under your link.

recap.title: Recap
recap.body: One short video covering the main points of the whole thing, with the points listed on screen.

trailer.title: Trailer
trailer.body: One short preview made to get people to watch the full video, without giving away the ending.

instructions.title: Add your own direction
instructions.body: Whichever you pick, add a note like “only the funny moments” and the clips follow it.

settings.title: Everything else lives here
settings.body: Length, captions, framing, cleanup, and B-roll are now in one menu. We remember your choices, so you only set them once.
